title: fix(create-objectstack): a project name that starts with the template namespace scaffolds instead of being refused
body:
Fixes #22911
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`create-objectstack blank-probe` exited 1 with "1 object name(s) still carry the template's 'blank_' prefix ... This is a bug in the scaffolder". The rewrite itself was right (`blank_note` became `blank_probe_note`). The self-check after it, `findStaleNamespacePrefixes`, tested each name against the template prefix alone, and `blank_probe_note` starts with `blank_` because the new namespace `blank_probe` does.

Per the triage direction (comment 6115833632), a name is now stale only when it starts with the old prefix **and does not** start with the new namespace's prefix:

- `packages/create-objectstack/src/rewrite-identity.ts`: `findStaleNamespacePrefixes(dir, oldNs, newNs)` takes the new namespace as a required third argument. Each old-prefixed `name:` literal on a line is checked against the same `namePrefixRe` built from the new namespace. One predicate for every template namespace, with no exemption for `blank`. The check runs per literal, so a correct name on a line cannot hide a stale one on the same line.
- `packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts`: the one caller passes the `namespace` it has just written. Nothing outside the package imports the function. The only other `rewrite-identity` mentions are comments, and the package's `exports` map publishes `./created-summary` only.
- Error text and rewrite logic are unchanged.

## Measured at the public door

Repo-built CLI (`tsx packages/create-objectstack/src/index.ts blank-probe --skip-install --skip-skills`):

| tree | exit | result |
|---|---|---|
| base `eab7236ff7` | 1 | `Scaffolding rewrote the namespace to 'blank_probe' but 1 object name(s) still carry the template's 'blank_' prefix: src/objects/note.object.ts:6  name: 'blank_probe_note',` |
| this PR `8679418942` | 0 | `src/objects/note.object.ts:6  name: 'blank_probe_note',` and `objectstack.config.ts:27  namespace: 'blank_probe',` |

## Tests

- `rewrite-identity.test.ts`: the two existing `findStaleNamespacePrefixes` cases now pass the new namespace. A new `describe.each` runs over `blank → blank_probe` and `todo → todo_list`, so the same pins run under two template namespaces. It has three cases:
  - after the rewrite, nothing is stale;
  - CONTROL: without the rewrite, the genuinely stale `OLD_note` is still reported;
  - a line carrying a correct name and a stale one is still reported.
- `scaffold-namespace-extends-template.test.ts` (new) drives the real CLI through `tsx`, the pattern `scaffold-description.test.ts` uses. There is one case per bundled template in `TEMPLATES`. Each probe project is named from that template's own namespace (`blank` gives `blank-probe`). The case asserts:
  - exit 0;
  - the scaffolded namespace is `blank_probe`;
  - every template-prefixed name moved to `blank_probe_*`;
  - each name passes the spec's own `validateObjectNamespacePrefix`.
- Runs at `8679418942`, through the shared verify lock:
  - `pnpm --filter create-objectstack exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` followed by `pnpm --filter create-objectstack run typecheck`: `Test Files 18 passed (18)`, `Tests 261 passed (261)`, `tsc --noEmit` clean, `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
  - `tsc --noEmit --listFiles` includes both touched test files (18 test files in the program).

### Ablation (committed fix, two legs, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` WRAP mode with a restore trap)

The anchor was `if (literals.some((literal) => !newRe.test(literal))) {`. For each leg the on-disk count went anchor 1 → 0 and replacement 0 → 1, and the blob changed.

- **Leg A**: `if (literals.length > 0) {`, the pre-fix predicate (old prefix alone). Predicted red; observed red: `Tests 3 failed | 26 passed (29)`. The failures were both "reports nothing once the rewrite has run" cases and the scaffold case, which printed the original `✗ Scaffolding rewrote the namespace to 'blank_probe' but 1 object name(s) still carry the template's 'blank_' prefix`.
- **Leg B**: `if (literals.length > 0 && !newRe.test(lines[i])) {`, a line-level predicate. Predicted red; observed red: `Tests 2 failed | 27 passed (29)`. The failures were both "judges each literal" cases.
- **Restore**, after each leg and again in the trap: `blob == HEAD (35eae3f4e754) and git diff HEAD is empty`, porcelain empty.

No `dist/` is involved: the unit tests import `./rewrite-identity.js` from `src/`, and the scaffold test runs `src/index.ts` through `tsx`.

## Edge answers (measured, one-off probe on `8679418942`)

| case | old → new | name on disk | stale |
|---|---|---|---|
| forward, rewritten | `blank` → `blank_probe` | `blank_probe_note` | 0 |
| forward, no rewrite | `blank` → `blank_probe` | `blank_note` | 1 |
| reverse, rewritten | `blank_probe` → `blank` | `blank_note` | 0 |
| reverse, no rewrite | `blank_probe` → `blank` | `blank_probe_note` | 0 |
| equal | `blank` → `blank` | `blank_note` | 0 |
| disjoint, no rewrite | `blank` → `my_app` | `blank_note` | 1 |

The "reverse, no rewrite" row reads 0 because `blank_probe_note` is legal under namespace `blank` (`blank_` + `probe_note`). The project would not be rejected, which is the question the check answers. The caller never calls the check for "equal" (`namespace !== templateNamespace` guard).

After `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/objectql...' build` (under the lock, `VERDICT command-exit 0`), the re-run gave exit 0: "✓ check-lean-entry-closure: 2 published condition(s) measured from a real load".

## Lint (proven narrowing; `pnpm lint` is CI's)

- **Population** (from `eslint.config.mjs`): `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}']` minus `NEVER_LINTED`. `eslint --print-config` returns a config for each of the 4 touched `.ts` files (5 to 6 rules each), so none is ignored.
- **Count** (from `--format json`): 4 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings, run with `--no-inline-config` as `pnpm lint` does.
- **Invariance**: the config never enables type-aware linting. Every `parserOptions` is `{ ecmaVersion, sourceType }`, with no `project` or `projectService`. Its only disk reads are its own baselines, so this diff cannot move a verdict on any untouched file.

## Acceptance notes

- The "second template" pin does not apply today. `TEMPLATES` in `template-registry.ts` holds only `blank`, and `src/templates/` holds only `blank/` and `AGENTS.md`. The scaffold-level pin iterates `TEMPLATES` and names each probe from that template's own namespace, so a second template is pinned on registration.
- The reverse case (a template namespace `X_Y` with project namespace `X`) cannot be reached with the bundled template, because `blank` contains no underscore. If a rewrite were skipped there, the check would pass names that are already legal under the new namespace. That is consistent with the decided predicate, not a defect.
- `origin/main` moved two commits after this branch was cut (`3caae97942`, `018b077fbf`). Both touch `packages/objectql` only, and `git diff --stat eab7236ff7 origin/main -- packages/create-objectstack` is empty. They were not merged in; the merge queue rebuilds on `main`.
- Changeset `.changeset/22911-blank-prefixed-project-name.md` is `create-objectstack: patch`, with `Clause-②: no`.
